sections.Profile:
The "Handicap" pinball machine, released by Williams Manufacturing Company on June 19, 1952, is a single-player electro-mechanical game designed by Harry Mabs, with artwork by George Molentin.

- Manufacturer: Williams Electronic Games Inc.
- Years made: 1952
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
- Display: Reels
- Players: 1
- Tags: Single Player, Backbox Gimmick, Wood Rail, Sports, Horses, Original Theme, Horse Racing
